notes.1.301: rs.wt ḥr=s, rendered 'watched over', may instead be 'dreams concerning it'.

nodes.text: The ba comes to the place it knows; it does not stray from its paths of yesterday; no magic can repel it; it reaches those who give it water.
He made magic for them as weapons, to ward off the blow of what happens, watched over by night as by day.
